title: Brand3 Deep Research Evidence Packet Trial

comparison.current_brand3_pipeline: Feature raw values double as evidence containers and get flattened by dimension.
comparison.deep_research_trial: Evidence classes were separated into audited surface, owned claims, external evidence, technical signals, trust/security, ambiguity, excluded noise, and eligibility.

comparison.current_brand3_pipeline: Kit and BuiltWith evidence can mix inside the same dimension pool.
comparison.deep_research_trial: Subdomain name collision was explicitly named and not smoothed into positioning.

comparison.current_brand3_pipeline: Technical signals such as robots.txt or visual metrics can become findings.
comparison.deep_research_trial: Technical infrastructure was marked not eligible for findings.

comparison.current_brand3_pipeline: Direct web scrape captured audited surface content.
comparison.deep_research_trial: The packet reported direct inspection data from builtwith.kit.com as unavailable and relied on ScamAdviser.

comparison.current_brand3_pipeline: Cost distributed across collectors and LLM calls.
comparison.deep_research_trial: About USD 0.56 estimated for one URL-context-only task.

root_finding: Deep Research produced cleaner classification discipline for the Builtwith failure class, but did not prove it can replace acquisition because direct audited-surface evidence was incomplete.

recommendation.recommended_next_step: Specify a Deep Research Evidence Packet Contract and compare it against a deterministic local Information-to-Evidence Contract.
